department: Faculty of Engineering (IV), coordinated by its departments

deadline.value: There is no common deadline; each applicant applies when a supervisor and funding are in place.
deadline.quote: There is no common application deadline

also.quote: The deadlines vary depending upon the individual vacancies

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on NTNU's PhD pages.

supervisor.value: The main supervisor should be ready when you apply, and early contact with a research group is advised.
supervisor.quote: The main supervisor should be ready when you apply for the programme

funding.value: Most NTNU PhD candidates are paid research fellows, but funding must be documented before admission.
funding.quote: Most PhD candidates at NTNU are employed as PhD research fellows (stipendiat) at NTNU or a university college.

entry_route.value: Five years of higher education including a master's degree or other equivalent degree is needed.
entry_route.quote: completed at least five years of higher education that includes a master's degree or other equivalent degree

notes: PHIV, the umbrella PhD in Engineering. The programme page says: "Read more about our research and the PhD programme in Engineering on our departments web pages: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering ... Department of Geoscience ...". That basis gives also_fields civil and earth. PhD in Nautical Operations (https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/phnaut) is not a field here. No department fee, GRE or English rule.
